title: StorageError missing Clone/PartialEq derives
description: error.rs: StorageError derives only Debug but not Clone or PartialEq, while ValidationError, ProtocolError, and SigningError all derive Clone+PartialEq. The inconsistency means StorageError cannot be used in test assertions with assert_eq!, cannot be stored in data structures requiring Clone, and is a surprising exception. The only field preventing Clone+PartialEq is StorageError::EntryNotFound(LogEntryId) — LogEntryId already derives Clone+PartialEq — so there is no technical barrier. Without the derives, test code must use matches!() instead of assert_eq!, which produces worse error messages on test failure.
